offering_description.value: Operates online marketplaces where independent sellers list handmade, vintage and unique goods for buyers worldwide. Also owns Reverb (musical instruments) and Depop (secondhand fashion). Earns money from fees and seller services on its platforms.

primary_services.value: online marketplace platforms; seller advertising; payment processing; shipping label services

customer_segment.value: B2C: Individual shoppers buying handmade, vintage, fashion and instrument items; B2B: Independent sellers and small businesses buying listings, promotion and shipping services

end_markets.value: online retail; handmade and craft goods; vintage and secondhand fashion; musical instruments; home decor

revenue_model.value: transaction or usage fees: transaction and listing fees charged to sellers on sales; advertising: sellers pay for promoted listings and onsite ads; service fees: payment processing fees and shipping label purchases
revenue_model.category: transaction or usage fees; advertising; service fees

value_chain_position.value: software / platform: runs marketplaces connecting independent sellers with buyers, takes in seller listings, serves consumers and sellers

geography_served.value: global: US, UK, Germany, Canada, France, Australia, India and many other countries

specialization.value: related lines: Etsy, Reverb and Depop marketplaces sharing seller-to-buyer model and fee structure

distribution_channels.value: online: company websites and mobile apps

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: consumer protection, data privacy (GDPR, CCPA), payments, marketplace tax collection and intellectual property rules
